title: [18/8/2024] Number of people who used different communication services
prompt: The line graph shows the number of people who used different communication services in the world. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make a comparison where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph illustrates the number of people per 100 inhabitants who utilized five different types of communication services worldwide over a 10-year period from 1998 to 2008.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, all communication services showed an increase in the number of users over the given period. Additionally, cellular phone service experienced the most significant growth and became the most popular means of communication from 2002 onwards.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the more widely used services, landline had the highest number of users at approximately 14 per 100 inhabitants in 1998, compared to just 5 for cellular phones and 4 for internet service. The figure for cellular phones then increased dramatically, surpassing landline service in 2002 with about 18 users, before rising sharply to reach around 63 users per 100 inhabitants by 2008. In contrast, landline service remained relatively stable at between 16 and 20 users throughout the period, while internet service showed steady growth, reaching approximately 23 users per 100 inhabitants in 2008.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the less popular services, both fixed and mobile broadband had virtually no users in 1998. These services saw modest increases over the decade, with fixed broadband rising to about 6 users and mobile broadband reaching approximately 5 users per 100 inhabitants by 2008.
